name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including content, client/project association, portal visibility and private communication drafts. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; explicit exits restore that context, while direct or untrusted origins fall back safely. A discreet `Documentos / ...` path under the title exposes every real folder ancestor as a hoverable link back to that folder, including the root and unassigned locations. The responsive header clamps long titles, keeps portal visibility and client metadata independent, and shows concurrent state episodes with their duration. The Acciones menu remains separate from the non-wrapping Cancelar/Guardar pair. The compact notes entry performs an immediate notes-only PATCH for client messages and legacy custom notes, leaving unrelated page edits pending; normalized observations use the audited state workflow and may link to needs-fix. Failed saves keep the modal draft open. Stored commercial-proposal versions and issued collection accounts open as immutable PDF records: identity, association, folder, messages and workflow controls are read-only, the exact archived PDF is previewed and downloaded once, and private observations remain manageable. The contract window (the document linked to the one contract template) opens read-only too: it previews the live draft PDF the client downloads, exports it as PDF or Markdown, and offers no editor, rename, move, duplicate, archive or delete. Markdown tools, contained template previews with bounded scrolling and dual PDF download remain available only for editable Markdown documents.
